Players Committee card image of [[Perimeter Scan (V)]] (original printing), game text: “USED: Play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect. OR Target opponent's just-deployed [Maintenance] card. Target may not battle (or allow opponent to deploy cards from Reserve Deck) for remainder of turn. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: Cancel Trample (unless targeting an Undercover spy).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/perimeterscan.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
